text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer. We're steadily 
growing as a team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've taken the liberty of preparing some 
refreshments again, and—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I've upgraded the club room even further!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for even greater growth, work 
together as a team and do your best♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the heartfelt refreshments and 
the club room's further upgrades, the 
team's spirits soared, and their bonds 
deepened!
